title: Glitch / retro
prompt: Glitchy retro title card for a synthwave podcast called "NIGHT SIGNAL". RGB-split text (offset magenta/cyan copies of the title that jitter), horizontal scanline bars that tear across, a few hard flicker frames, CRT-ish dark purple background with a sun-gradient stripe. Glitches come in bursts — stable moments in between.

checklist.text: RGB split: ≥3 copies of the title text
jitter (hold keys, many small keys or random/wiggle expressions)
bursts with stable moments in between
